title: One still homepage artwork per visit
authorization_quote: Instead of rotating - may be load a new on every visit?
implementation: Replaced automatic rotation with one randomly selected still image per homepage load. When browser storage is available, the previous artwork is excluded. Slideshow controls and animations are removed; captions, responsive images and static fallback remain.
Only the last artwork path is saved locally; no visitor identifier or network tracking is introduced. Storage failures fall back to random choice.
Selection occurs once on initialization. A failed selected image restores the initial image and caption. With no JavaScript, the first scene remains visible.
A visit means a new homepage document load or refresh. Restoring the same document from browser history does not change its artwork.
